urgent.title: EQT applications close today. Superday prep
urgent.detail: SEO London recommended you on 6 Nov. Applications close today (12 Nov) and the Superday is 26 Nov, so an invite could land any day from now. Tell SEO London the moment you get it. Prep the case study, EQT Real Estate's logistics and living strategies, and use what Jay told you on the Zoom yesterday.

urgent.title: Accept Damon Wilson's Blackstone invite (17 Nov)
urgent.detail: Catch-up Tue 17 Nov, 17:00 at Berkeley Square House (Crystal Palace room, 3rd floor). It still shows 'needs action' on both your Gmail and Bayes calendars. Accept it, then prepare 3 questions.

urgent.title: Set your spend ceiling before the challenge ends
urgent.detail: The AI Income Challenge runs to Sun 15 Nov, 17:00 VIP and 18:00 main (UK time). These usually end with a paid upsell. Decide now what you'd pay, if anything, and what you'd need to see first. Write one product idea you'll test this month.

urgent.title: Finish your DataAnnotation assessment
urgent.detail: You signed up on 11 Nov and the next step is picking and taking the assessment. It's paid remote AI-training work, so it could count toward your side-income target. Check the pay and hours before committing.

urgent.title: Check your Evercore Private Funds Group status
urgent.detail: Your video interview was due 6 Sep and there's been no email since. Log into the portal, confirm whether it's live or closed, then update the tracker.
